title: The Surprising Effectiveness of PPO in Cooperative Multi-Agent Games
authors: Chao Yu; Akash Velu; Eugene Vinitsky; Jiaxuan Gao; Yu Wang; Alexandre Bayen; Yi Wu
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35, Datasets and Benchmarks Track
architecture: decentralized actor with centralized value function; GAE and clipped PPO updates
data_environment: particle environments; SMAC; Hanabi; Google Research Football
metrics: return and sample efficiency with implementation ablations
limitations: benchmark findings do not establish cyber-defense safety or equilibrium
relevance: Supports MAPPO as a strong cooperative baseline and motivates explicit implementation diagnostics
evidence_location: Official paper pp. 1 and 5-8; supplementary material Section A

title: Scalable Constrained Policy Optimization for Safe Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Lijun Zhang; Lin Li; Wei Wei; Huizhong Song; Yaodong Yang; Jiye Liang
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37
architecture: sequential local policy updates with kappa-hop interactions and local constraints
baselines: centralized safe MARL and unconstrained variants
limitations: not a cyber-defense study; local-interaction assumptions must be checked before transfer
relevance: Motivates separating operational budgets and safety constraints from reward shaping
evidence_location: Official paper pp. 1-3 and algorithm sections; NeurIPS abstract

title: A Review of Safe Reinforcement Learning: Methods, Theories, and Applications
authors: Shangding Gu; Long Yang; Yali Du; Guang Chen; Florian Walter; Jun Wang; Alois Knoll
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 46(12):11216-11235
method: review and taxonomy of safe RL
limitations: review evidence does not turn a bounded cyber action map into a formal safety guarantee
relevance: Provides terminology for constraints, deployment safety and honest claim boundaries

title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Cyber Network Defense
authors: Aditya Vikram Singh; Ethan Rathbun; Emma Graham; Lisa Oakley; Simona Boboila; Alina Oprea; Peter Chin
method: hierarchical PPO with expert or learned master policy
architecture: PPO sub-policies for investigate, recover and traffic-control actions plus a master selector
metrics: episodic return; clean-host ratio; recovery precision; false positives; recovery time
limitations: preprint evidence; transfer beyond the tested CybORG scenarios remains open
relevance: Supports a distinct hierarchical baseline and interpretable cyber metrics rather than reward alone

title: A method of network attack-defense game and collaborative defense decision-making based on hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning
authors: Yunlong Tang; Jing Sun; Huan Wang; Junyi Deng; Liang Tong; Wenhong Xu
model: Stackelberg hypergame for incomplete-information cyber conflict
architecture: high-level defense strategy selection and lower-level action decisions
baselines: other cyber-defense strategies reported by the paper
limitations: full architecture and protocol details require the legally obtained article PDF
relevance: Provides a peer-reviewed cyber-game comparison for hierarchical action decomposition
evidence_location: Official ScienceDirect metadata and abstract; full PDF requested

title: Causally aware reinforcement learning agents for autonomous cyber defence
authors: Tom Purves; Konstantinos G. Kyriakopoulos; Sian Jenkins; Iain Phillips; Tim Dudman
method: PPO with a causal reward model
architecture: modified PPO agent with causal context in reward construction
metrics: blue wins; episode length; healthy and isolated nodes
limitations: causal reward evidence does not imply causal identification of the physical propagation model
relevance: Supports reporting operational state metrics alongside return
evidence_location: Official open-access ScienceDirect abstract and highlights

title: Physics-informed PointNet: A deep learning solver for steady-state incompressible flows and thermal fields on multiple sets of irregular geometries
architecture: PointNet-style geometry encoder with PDE; boundary and sparse-data losses
baselines: standard single-geometry PINNs and numerical references described by the paper
metrics: field errors and generalization to unseen geometries
limitations: steady PDE geometry results do not directly validate a graph ODE inverse model
relevance: Motivates node-feature encoders and held-out graph geometry tests without claiming architectural equivalence
evidence_location: Official ScienceDirect metadata; abstract and Section 3 preview; full PDF requested

title: Optimal control of PDEs using physics-informed neural networks
method: PINN control with independent rollout validation
architecture: separate state and control networks with weighted objective and PDE residual terms
data_environment: Laplace; Burgers; Kuramoto-Sivashinsky; Navier-Stokes control examples
metrics: objective and constraint residuals under independent forward evaluation
limitations: PDE results and loss-weight search do not establish identifiability or optimality for cyber ODEs
relevance: Supports independent rollout checks and comparison with adjoint/FBSM baselines
evidence_location: Official ScienceDirect Sections 1-4 preview; full PDF requested

title: Physics-informed neural nets for control of dynamical systems
authors: Eric Aislan Antonelo; Eduardo Camponogara; Laio Oriel Seman; Jean Panaioti Jordanou; Eduardo Rehbein de Souza; Jomi Fred Hubner
architecture: network conditioned on time; initial state and control with chained short-interval predictions
data_environment: Van der Pol oscillator; four-tank system; electric submersible pump
limitations: autoregressive interval chaining can accumulate error and requires independent long-horizon validation
relevance: Motivates conditioning a neural dynamics model on initial state and control rather than training one trajectory only
evidence_location: Official ScienceDirect metadata and Sections 1-4 preview; full PDF requested

title: LyZNet with Control: Physics-Informed Neural Network Control of Nonlinear Systems with Formal Guarantees
authors: Jun Liu; Yiming Meng; Ruikun Zhou
method: PINN policy iteration with formal verification
architecture: physics-informed HJB policy iteration coupled to Lyapunov verification
baselines: unverified learned controller and prior LyZNet workflow
metrics: performance and verified region of attraction
limitations: formal guarantees depend on the verifier and assumptions; residual minimization alone is insufficient
relevance: Supports separating training residuals from independent verification claims

title: Pontryagin neural operator for solving general-sum differential games with parametric state constraints
authors: Lei Zhang; Mukesh Ghimire; Zhe Xu; Wenlong Zhang; Yi Ren
venue: Proceedings of the 6th Learning for Dynamics and Control Conference, PMLR 242:1728-1740
model: general-sum differential games with parametric state constraints
architecture: value and costate networks with forward/backward costate consistency losses
baselines: hybrid neural operator and HJI/PINN baselines
metrics: value; policy; costate and safety performance
limitations: method addresses a different feedback-learning problem than the open-loop FBSM examples
relevance: Supports a clearly labeled advanced route from PMP costates to neural operators
evidence_location: Official PMLR paper pp. 1-6; Eq. 6; Algorithm 1
